title: hotfix: ensure per-region SLO enforcement and prevent global circuit-breaker triggering
author: Leah Carter
description:
Context: During a recent incident (SUP-8421) the SLO enforcer could enter a state where a spike in latency in one region caused the global circuit-breaker to open, triggering cross-region failovers and cascading capacity issues. This PR fixes two related problems: 1) SLO enforcement counters were aggregated without region tags in the short-term window, and 2) the circuit-breaker evaluation logic was using a global summarization path that could be tripped by racey updates.

What this change does: Consolidates SLO metrics to be region-scoped in the short-term evaluation path, makes circuit-breaker state sharded by region by default, and adds a configuration knob to force-global behavior for legacy customers. Adds a conservative rollout plan and extra unit/integration tests.

Checklist:
- [x] Fix metric aggregation to include region tag in short window (slo_enforcer.py)
- [x] Make circuit-breaker state sharded by region, with optional global fallback (circuit_breaker.py)
- [x] Add mutex around state update to prevent races in high-concurrency code path
- [x] Add unit + integration tests covering per-region triggers and failover behavior
- [x] Update observability to add per-region CB metrics and dashboard notes
- [x] Documentation: add upgrade note and new config flag

Notes: This is a hotfix — changes are intentionally narrow and contained to the enforcer and CB modules. We avoided altering long-term aggregation logic and infra telemetry retention. Related: ENG-9374 tracks a broader refactor of SLO windows scheduled in Q2.

a1c4f2e: fix: shard circuit-breaker state by region, add global_fallback config (circuit_breaker.py)
d9f0b8a: fix: add lock around cb state updates to prevent races (circuit_breaker.py)
2c3e4a7: test: add unit tests for per-region SLO triggers and CB behavior (tests/slo/test_enforcer.py)
f4b1e0c: docs: add release note + config docs (docs/operational/slo_enforcer.md)
review_comments:
Diego Morales (review): Can you clarify the new config key name and default? Also suggest adding a short migration note for Dedicated customers.
Author: Default key is 'slo.enforcer.shard_by_region' = true. Added migration note to docs and defaults.yaml.

Priya Raman (review): The new lock looks fine but add a micro-benchmark to ensure we don't regress tail latency under high concurrency.
Author: Added a lightweight microbench in tests that asserts <2% overhead at 95th pct in CI environment; kept the lock scoped to only the state mutation.

Owen Zhang (review): CI flake in test_integration: test_failover_timing is flaky on busy agents. Consider increasing timing slack.
Author: Increased timeout and added a retry loop in the integration test; CI passed on rerun.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash-merge after 2 approvals and CI green. Rollout plan: canary to us-west-2 (10%) for 30m, observe per-region CB metrics; then 100% rollout across regions. Hotfix applied to production at 2026-02-20 15:42 UTC.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fixes an issue where a regional latency spike could open a global circuit-breaker causing unnecessary cross-region failover. Circuit-breaker is now sharded by region by default (slo.enforcer.shard_by_region=true). Added observability metrics for per-region CB state and guidance for Dedicated customers.
rationale: Per-region enforcement prevents cascading failovers and preserves capacity isolation. The change is conservative, feature-flagged via config, and covered by tests and metrics for safe rollout.
